data.name: Godric
data.long_meaning: From the Old English 'God' meaning 'god' and 'ric' meaning 'power'. This name was popular among the Anglo-Saxons and Normans.
data.spiritual_meaning: Remember your divine connection and tap into the power of the universe.

in_hebrew.name: גודריק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם גודריק נגזר מהמילים העבריות 'אלוהים' (אלוהים) ו'ריק' (שולט), ומשמעותו 'אלוהים הוא השליט שלי' או 'השליט האלוהי'. השם מורכב מרכיבים עבריים וגרמניים, ומשקף את הקשר בין האדם לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Γκόντρικ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γκόντρικ προέρχεται από τους Γερμανικούς όρους 'god' (θεός) και 'ric' (βασιλιάς), και σημαίνει 'θεοδικός' ή 'αυτός που κυβερνά με τη θεία βοήθεια'. Στην ιστορία της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Godricus
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Godricus ex vocibus Latinis 'Deus' et 'ricus' (imperator) derivatur, significans 'Dei imperator' vel 'Imperator divinus'. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc pietatem et devotionem ad Deum reflectit.

in_english.name: Godric
in_english.meaning: Divine ruler or ruler of God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Godric originates from the Old English words 'god' (divine) and 'ric' (ruler), meaning 'divine ruler' or 'ruler of God'. It reflects a strong connection between the individual and the divine, signifying a person of spiritual leadership and devotion. Historically, the name has been associated with Christian traditions and has been borne by several saints and nobles throughout history.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Godric" carries a sense of strong, divine power, emphasizing the Anglo-Saxon and Norman roots. It was common among those of noble and religious backgrounds, suggesting a connection to the divine and a powerful spiritual influence.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Godric" evokes a deep spiritual connection to the Christian god, emphasizing the power and presence of the deity in one's life. It serves as a constant reminder of the faith and devotion that underpin the name, offering a sense of protection and guidance from the divine.

historical_references.reference: Godric of Finchale was an English hermit who lived in the 11th century. He is best known for founding Finchale Priory, a monastic community for hermits.
historical_references.context: During the Middle Ages, the hermit movement flourished in Europe as a form of religious and social expression. Godric's establishment of Finchale Priory reflects the growing trend towards monasticism and the desire for individual spiritual retreat.

historical_references.reference: Godric of Danemark, also known as Saint Godric, was a Norse lord who converted to Christianity and became a monk in the late 10th or early 11th century. He is believed to have spent the latter part of his life as a hermit and pilgrim in England.
historical_references.context: Godric of Danemark's conversion to Christianity during a time of religious and political transition in Europe reflects the growing influence of Christianity in Norse society. His decision to become a hermit and pilgrim underscores the appeal of the ascetic life for some individuals in the medieval period.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Godric has seen a resurgence in modern culture, particularly in the contexts of neo-paganism, gaming, and literature. In neo-pagan communities, Godric is sometimes used as a name for deities associated with nature, strength, and protection. In the gaming world, Godric is a character in Blizzard's World of Warcraft, a human paladin and a revered figure in the game's lore. In literature, Godric is the name of the protagonist in the novel 'Godric' by Bernard Cornwell, a historical fiction account of a 10th-century Anglo-Saxon knight.

name_in_real_life.story: Grace Godric from New York, United States embodies the meaning of Godric - "God's Power". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Godric: God-ruler or God's power ruler. A name evoking strength and divine authority.
